findings.finding: Runtime schema verification accepted weakened or missing guards.
evidence: Committed release schema authority is regenerated in CI and compared exactly.
Current-release startup verifies migration lineage, objects, tables, columns, foreign keys, indexes, quick_check and append-only behavior.
Exact accepted historical migration prefixes remain valid forward-migration inputs; divergent lineage fails closed.

findings.finding: Default Reference lifecycle construction could omit required dependency validators.
evidence: ReferenceDependencyRegistry still fails closed unless explicitly finalized.
The pre-LLD-08 application composition root now registers InventoryReferenceDependencyValidator and finalizes the exact required owner set; the empty registry remains an explicit test-only seam.
A composed ReferenceLifecycleService regression proves a real active Spare Request requester blocks Contact archival.

findings.finding: RFC hierarchy mutation replay response failed at ordinary branch sizes.
evidence: Foundation default response bounds remain unchanged for ordinary schemas.

RfcBranchV1/v1 alone receives the reviewed 33554432-byte/depth-8/8192-item allocation. The normative conservative maximum-content construction is 23288983 bytes/depth-4/4151 items because accepted LLD-04 text may require six-byte canonical JSON escaping.
Future RfcBranch schema versions fail closed unless they receive their own exact reviewed allocation.

Regression coverage includes a real 101-child maximum-content mutation with continuation, exact immutable replay after later source drift, reparent capacity, byte/depth/item boundaries and unallocated-version rejection.

findings.finding: XLSX semantic parsing could consume changed path bytes after an earlier safe preflight.
evidence: Semantic parsers consume the immutable byte source produced by preflight rather than reopening the path.
Preflight identity includes SHA-256 over the retained bytes.
Immutable source resources close on success and parser rejection paths.

findings.finding: Inventory dependency continuation omitted part of the stable ordering key.
evidence: Continuation is versioned, target-bound and carries blocker_id plus reason_code.
Multi-role requester/receiver blockers traverse without ambiguity.

findings.finding: Bounded JSON measurement skipped tuple contents.
evidence: Tuple contents now participate in Unicode, depth and aggregate-item measurement equivalently to serialized arrays.

findings.finding: ReadSnapshot leaked an acquired connection when BEGIN failed.
evidence: ReadSnapshot entry failure closes and clears the acquired connection before re-raising.
Later runtime/UoW hardening preserved the injectable factory seam used by failure-path tests.

findings.finding: Foundation host lifecycle, readiness, diagnostics and status surfaces were absent.
evidence: HostRuntime cleanup now owns partially acquired security/server resources before provider calls return and retains instance ownership when stop/drain safety cannot be proven.
A single shutdown deadline is propagated through write/request/background drains and server stop; WAL checkpoint uses only the remaining busy budget.

A real Starlette/Uvicorn loopback smoke regression uses explicit test-only security seams, authenticated self-readiness, host-owned request executor dispatch, READY gating, HTTP shutdown, full cleanup and safe restart on the same data instance.
Production run/session security and SQLCipher provider integration remain LLD-12 obligations and are not claimed by the test seam.

2026-09-23 re-audit found the earlier failed-start ownership claim false: close(wait=False) let a running UoW outlive server/security/registry cleanup and OS lock release. The repaired ownership and drain regressions passed supported CI #868 at 4ed3b27c45e187fa1b73edab0c687f6cd1ec3a36; this does not certify all LLD-01 semantics.

findings.finding: Required Reference point/list/history query surfaces were missing.
evidence: GetReferenceById, ListActiveReferences, Customer Account Code history, Contact channels and Contact affiliation history are implemented with bounded keyset continuations.
Site-derived Dispatch address resolution remains behind SiteDispatchAddressProvider and reports UNAVAILABLE when LLD-08 is not assembled rather than importing future private tables.
History regressions are robust to whole-second timestamp ties by using the complete stable ordering key.

findings.finding: Reference dependency guards and previews repeatedly materialized complete blocker sets.
evidence: Authoritative archive guards no longer execute a compound UNION plus global ORDER BY; they run fixed per-owner LIMIT 1 existence probes and stop at the first blocker.
Preview count/page enumeration remains exact and uses UNION ALL with deterministic blocker_id/reason_code ordering and target-bound continuation.
Regression coverage asserts guard SQL shape and the requester index plan rather than inferring constant work from SELECT count alone.

findings.finding: Regroup acceptance recomputed global grouping candidates under the authoritative writer lock.
evidence: Expensive candidate planning moved outside the writer transaction.
Acceptance retains authoritative in-writer freshness/conflict revalidation and atomic mutation semantics.

findings.finding: Stock page executed per-unit blocker queries before slicing.
evidence: The earlier N+1 blocker projection repair is retained, but fixed SELECT count is no longer treated as a work-scaling proof.
Forward migration 12 adds only two expression/order indexes; historical migrations 1 through 11 remain byte-for-byte unchanged.

Stock page selection is partitioned by compatibility rank, preserves the exact compatibility/display/id cursor contract and exact_total, and uses direct index seeks rather than a temporary ORDER BY B-tree.
Dense and late-page VM-work regressions plus EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN assertions are now part of the current recertification candidate.

findings.finding: SLA warnings/cohorts reread accepted inputs and immutable policy rows.
evidence: Already validated ServiceRequestSlaInput can be reused in the same read snapshot.
Immutable policy-owner/tier reads use a snapshot-local exact-key cache, never a process-wide mutable cache.
Trace regressions prove one accepted-input read and one shared policy/tier read per exact snapshot key.

findings.finding: Selected serializers/helpers and computed locals were duplicated or redundant.
evidence: Proven unused computations were removed.
Product-Line/SLA cursor envelope construction is shared while query-specific validation remains local.
Report-attempt response projection is shared between query and worker.
Observed-row proposal draft conversion is shared without moving proposal authority.
Durable Ticket Import job JSON bounded decode is shared while job-specific validation remains local.

layout_divergence.note: The normative brace-family lists foundation/persistence/repositories.py, but no named command/query/service in the module map assigns authority to that generic file. Current Foundation persistence authority is implemented by specific connection/UoW/migration/job/runtime components. Recorded as layout divergence, not an audit blocker.

The normative map uses services/*, repositories/*, api/* and contracts/* filenames while the implementation retains earlier application/* owner modules plus focused query modules. Named behaviors audited here exist, including account-code review preview, channel-use validation, lifecycle preview, settings reads, profile setup participation, matching and the newly added owner queries. Filename parity was not manufactured with empty wrappers.

Several repositories remain internal to monolithic owner modules rather than the later repositories/* filenames. Named command/query/service behavior is present; this is source-layout traceability debt rather than evidence of missing authority.

residual_limits: LLD-08 Infrastructure has not started; Site-owned Reference clauses remain explicitly deferred to LLD-08 and are not pre-implemented by Reference.

LLD-12 production SQLCipher key-provider, authentication/session and final secure-host composition remain outside pre-LLD-08 certification; existing seams and non-security owner behavior are tested but do not substitute for LLD-12.
Generated-artifact recipient snapshot immutability remains consumer-owned where the consuming artifact packet has not yet been implemented; Reference address/channel history itself is certified.
Mechanical acceptance-marker coverage remains retrieval/reporting aid only; semantic ledgers and supported CI are the certification authority.

workstreams.scope: Foundation host lifecycle/status implementation is complete for pre-LLD-08 scope: canonical instance ownership precedes writer admission; STARTING/MIGRATING/VERIFYING/LISTENING_NOT_READY/READY/QUIESCING/STOPPED/FAILED states are owned by HostRuntime; failed-start resources are retained until safely drained; status/diagnostics are bounded. CI #946 is fully green. Final SQLCipher key-provider/security composition remains LLD-12-owned.

POSIX/Windows canonical instance locking is complete for pre-LLD-08 scope. POSIX retains the established lockf byte-range namespace, serializes same-process ownership, rejects hard-link aliases by device/inode identity, and defers alias descriptor close where closing could release the winning process-scoped lock. Dedicated race/alias regressions are supported by CI #946.

Host shutdown semantics are complete for pre-LLD-08 scope. One decreasing deadline budget is propagated across drain/server/checkpoint/security/cleanup stages; zero-grace still attempts nonblocking cleanup; failed drain/stop retains runtime ownership for retry; new work is rejected after quiescence. Dedicated shutdown regressions are supported by CI #946.

Measured-work and query-plan remediation is complete for the audited pre-LLD-08 surfaces. Inventory Stock uses bounded keyset partition seeks with fixed SELECT budget, index-plan assertions and bounded VM-step regressions; Reference lifecycle/query costs use finalized fail-closed dependency validators plus constant/indexed point/count work. CI #946 is fully green. LLD-08-owned Site behavior remains outside this workstream.

Semantic traceability closure is complete for LLD-01 through LLD-07. LLD-04 is certified across 92/92 normative cases; LLD-05 binds 91/91 normative acceptance/failure cases with no open semantic subclauses; remaining LLD-02 partial/deferred clauses are explicitly owned by future generated-artifact consumers, LLD-08 Site, or LLD-12 security rather than unresolved current-packet behavior. CI #946 certifies the complete production/runtime checkpoint.
